_comment: Expected publication outcome per basket name for the pre-deploy gate (scripts/valuation_canary_summary.py --expect). Change an entry only together with the engine change that explains it, and say why here. 2026-09-27: calibrated premium (3.24%) is the default.

NVDA.why: Calibrated premium lifts the DCF to about +57%; the 59-analyst Street target (+46%) covers more than half the move in the same direction.

MSFT.why: DCF about +14% with the calibrated premium; the Street (+12%) corroborates if it lands above 15%.

META.why: Calibrated premium lifts the DCF to about +23%; the Street target (+5%) covers less than half the move, so the boundary withholds and the answer leads with the model view.

GOOGL.why: DCF about +15% with the calibrated premium; the Street (+25%) corroborates if it lands above 15%.

CRH.why: DCF about +25% with the calibrated premium; the Street (+57%) corroborates.

TSLA.why: Consensus cash flows support a value far below the market; exit leg unavailable above the 80x boundary. Model view is shown, no rating.

AMD.why: DCF far below market on a 30%-capped fade; the Street target sits at the market, so nothing corroborates the gap.

AAPL.why: DCF-only, about -38% vs market; Street at the market.

AMZN.why: DCF about -34% vs market while the Street is +32%; model and Street disagree.

PYPL.why: DCF well above market while the Street target sits at the market.

MC.PA.why: Latest annual filing beyond the 200-day limit and no semiannual bridge.

PCJEWELLER.NS.why: Perpetual DCF is negative; a failed leg never publishes.

MU.why: Memory maker: DRAM/NAND prices set the covered years' margin, so the model is a scenario until a mid-cycle margin exists.

GM.why: GM Financial is a consolidated captive lender; scenario only until an operating/finance split exists.

TEX.why: Acquisition debt but no lending arm keeps its DCF. BORDERLINE: DCF about +74% needs the Street (+39%) to cover half the move (37%).

BKNG.why: Reports no cost of revenue in any year (expenses by function). It must build and pass integrity: before 2026-09-27 every Booking model failed the historical-period check, and payables measured against the absent line were projected at zero. Either publication outcome is accepted because the methods span right at the 1.8x limit: DCF about +34%, comps about +134% on Airbnb, Hilton and Royal Caribbean at 26.7x EBITDA versus Booking's own 12.2x.
